title: pvPlotDataOverTime
body:
## pvPlotDataOverTime

Builds time histories by updating the input at every time step it reports and collecting one attribute association (FieldAssociation: Points by ParaView default, Cells, Vertices, Edges or table Rows). Output is a multiblock of tables with a time column: by default one table of per-step statistics (minimum, maximum, quartiles and, for numeric arrays, mean and standard deviation) per input block, otherwise one table per tracked point or cell. Use it for convergence or transient monitoring of a region already reduced to what matters (a probe, slice or clipped zone).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Every time step is computed, so the cost is the number of steps times the upstream pipeline cost.
- With statistics off, every point or cell becomes its own table; on a large mesh reduce it first (e.g. pvProbeLocation).
- Elements are matched across steps by global ids, else by index; if the mesh changes over time, per-element histories may not follow the same physical location.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PlotDataOverTime`. Identity: `filters/PlotDataOverTime`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input from which the selection is extracted. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkTable","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FieldAssociation` | Select the attribute data to pass. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Points","Cells","Vertices","Edges","Rows"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Points"` |
| `OnlyReportSelectionStatistics` | If this property is set to 1, the min, max, inter-quartile ranges, and (for numeric arrays) mean and standard deviation of all the selected points or cells within each time step are reported -- instead of breaking each selected point's or cell's attributes out into separate time history tables. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
